missing_supplier_name.remediation: Enrich source data or add supplier name fallback from vendor ID.

uncategorised_spend.remediation: Run categorisation pipeline; add keyword rules or GL mappings for uncategorised GL codes.

unresolved_suppliers.description: Unique raw supplier names with no canonical ID resolved
unresolved_suppliers.remediation: Review supplier match log (PENDING status); lower fuzzy threshold or add manual overrides.

missing_payment_terms.description: Spend with no payment terms days populated
missing_payment_terms.remediation: Parse raw_payment_terms field; enrich from supplier master or contract data.

duplicate_invoice_risk.description: Rows sharing an (invoice_number, base_amount) key — potential duplicate payments
duplicate_invoice_risk.remediation: Review is_duplicate flag; investigate AP process for duplicate invoice controls.

negative_reversal_lines.description: Rows with negative base_amount (credit notes / reversals)
negative_reversal_lines.remediation: High reversal rates may indicate AP process issues or over-accruals; investigate with finance.

weak_descriptions.description: Rows with null, <5-word, or generic line description
weak_descriptions.remediation: Enrich descriptions from PO/contract data; add description enrichment rules.

missing_contract_linkage.description: Spend with neither a PO number nor a contract ID (uncontrolled spend)
missing_contract_linkage.remediation: Mandate PO creation for categories above threshold; implement contract catalogue.

missing_bu_cost_centre.description: Rows with no business unit and no cost centre
missing_bu_cost_centre.remediation: Enrich from GL account hierarchy; mandate BU/CC in AP data entry.
